description: Deterministically repair mechanical FlowZap Code errors: non-sequential node numbering, inferred edge handles, node/edge label syntax, missing lane display labels, emoji and non-printable characters. Returns the repaired code plus the list of corrections that were applied. Errors that cannot be repaired are reported as-is — the repairer never invents content.

lng.description: Language of the messages returned by this tool. Default: 'en'.

name: flowzap_fix
